name: Keyboard shortcuts
summary: Remap Claude Code's keyboard shortcuts to suit the way you work.
what: Shortcuts live in a keybindings file that maps keys to actions in different parts of the interface. You can change, remove or chain keys, and changes apply without a restart.

impact.title: Your keys, your way
impact.detail: Move any action to a key you prefer.

impact.title: Chords
impact.detail: Combine several keys in a row for one action.

howItWorks: Add bindings per context, using action names such as chat:externalEditor.
Set a key to null to unbind it.
A few keys, like Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D, are reserved.
